MR Safety
The Kestrel Neurostimulation System is MR Conditional. A person with the Kestrel Neurostimulation System may be safely scanned under the following conditions. Failure to follow these conditions may result in injury.
Parameter Condition
Device Name Kestrel Neurostimulation System
Device Configuration Stimulation OFF
Static Magnetic Field Strength (B0) 1.5T only
Type of Nuclei 31P (phosphorus)
Maximum Spatial Field Gradient 1,900 gauss/cm
Maximum Gradient Slew Rate 150 T/m/s per axis
RF Coil Type head transmit/receive coil only
Receive with the head transmit/receive coil
Operating Mode Normal Operating Mode
RF Conditions Maximum Whole-Body SAR 2 W/kg
Scan Regions Landmark the scan at least 30 cm away from the implanted pulse generator
